description:
You will be responsible for the quality of software development and deployment, reviewing software requirements and preparing test scenarios.

You will be in charge of day-to-day Quality Assurance during the development phase.

You will be involved in performing tests to ensure the software created by developers is fit for purpose and you will collaborate closely with other team members and departments.

You will analyze the test results and prepare reports on all aspects related to the software testing carried out.

This is a great opportunity to work on new and exciting projects, either on music or on gaming accessories.

Key responsibilities:

• Reviewing requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback
• Write, update and execute test cases in accordance with the requirements
• Estimate, prioritize and plan testing activities
• Reports and escalate issues to development teams and document them in issue tracking systems
• Follow-up issues, confirm fixing and close
• Maintain testing documentation with the latest project updates
• Perform Exploratory, Smoke, Regression, Interrupts, Compatibility and Performance testing
• Implement quality assurance best practices and procedures
• Stay updated on emerging technologies, and best practices related to software testing.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise:

  • 1-3 years experience in Software QA
  • Knowledge of QA methodologies and processes
  • Good understanding of lifecycle development, testing phases (especially in Agile methodology) and test case design
  • Attention to details with the ability to detect and track software defects and inconsistencies
  • Good knowledge of computer setup (installing applications, drivers) and hardware PC architecture
  • Experience working with Mantis (or Jira) and with Test Management tools (Testrail)
  • Good knowledge of Windows and MacOS operating systems
  • The enthusiasm for the QA process in a development environment
  • A QA approach from the end-user perspective
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Good written and verbal English skills

  • Bonuses - based on your results or/and the company’s;

A designer and manufacturer of interactive entertainment hardware and accessories, listed on the stock market since 1998 and active in this field since, Guillemot Corporation bases its activities around its two flagship brands: Hercules and Thrustmaster.

 

Thrustmaster takes pride in its core values, ‘Passion, Quality and Innovation’, and constantly strives to improve the realism and immersiveness in legendary game worlds by offering thrilling and truly exceptional experiences. From video game enthusiasts to casual gamers, Thrustmaster accessories for PC and gaming consoles such as racing wheels (Ferrari® F1 wheel replica and the powerful T-GT just to name some) and joysticks (US Air Force licensed) bring everyone’s dreams to life.  

Hercules: For over 30 years, we have focused on innovating and developing digital audio solutions which continue to inspire users with endless new possibilities. We constantly draw on our roots in analog audio, in order to offer cutting-edge devices, celebrated for their precision and sound quality.

Hercules created the first dual-deck mixing controller for computers featuring a built-in audio interface. Since then, Hercules has ranked among the leading manufacturers of portable DJ controllers for computers.
